about: no-edition-check's ignores are generated from policy/layers.json (2.1-M211, ADR 0030): the test files, the generated-area rows and the edition roots, the L5 rows of one edition (status new included, so editions/ is exempt the commit it lands); a single-edition row below L5 (app.tsx) or a both-edition adapter row (platform/) is feature code and counted. A hand-added or dropped ignore in any document is drift that --check names and a write restores.

written.policy/ast-grep/rules/no-edition-check.t:
id: no-edition-check.tsx
language: tsx
severity: error
message: "no-edition-check: edition tests; owner none; example desktop/web/src/app/a.ts"
files:
  - "{desktop/web,policy/fixtures/rules/*}/src/**/*.tsx"
ignores:
  - "{desktop/web,policy/fixtures/rules/*}/src/__tests__/**"
  - "{desktop/web,policy/fixtures/rules/*}/src/**/__fixtures__/**"
  - "{desktop/web,policy/fixtures/rules/*}/src/**/*.test.ts"
  - "{desktop/web,policy/fixtures/rules/*}/src/**/*.test.tsx"
  - "{desktop/web,policy/fixtures/rules/*}/src/generated/**"
  - "{desktop/web,policy/fixtures/rules/*}/src/main.tsx"
  - "{desktop/web,policy/fixtures/rules/*}/src/web/**"
  - "{desktop/web,policy/fixtures/rules/*}/src/editions/web/**"
rule:
  kind: string
  regex: ^['"](web|desktop)['"]$
